title: Edgar Bracket 4
subtitle: No holds barred: the drain/combo core the strongest Edgar lists share, every infinite allowed, combat kept as a ten-slot second route.
diagnosis: Brief (2026-11-03): the pilot wants the strongest Edgar possible for Bracket 4 pods, infinite combos included, no card-price limit, and asked whether to lean drain or aggro. Measured answer: at the top of the field there is no lean. EDHREC's cEDH combo average (44 decks) and cEDH aggro average (33 decks) share 54 of about 67 nonland cards, and both carry the same loop suite (Exquisite Blood and Bloodthirsty Conqueror with Vito and Sanguine Bond, plus Oathsworn Vampire with Phyrexian Altar), Necropotence, Bolas's Citadel, Dark Ritual and six or more tutors. The aggro version only spends its last dozen slots on lords and Shared Animosity instead of moxen. The pilot chose the drain/combo core, allowed automatic infinites, declined stax that only stifles opponents (Opposition Agent, Drannith Magistrate), kept Esper Sentinel because it draws us cards, and asked for a held hate section in the pool.

The loop suite is two 'opponent loses, you gain' halves (Exquisite Blood, Bloodthirsty Conqueror) times five 'you gain, opponent loses' halves (Vito, Sanguine Bond, Marauding Blight-Priest, Enduring Tenacity, Cliffhaven Vampire): ten two-card infinites, each half a fair drain card alone. The third engine is Oathsworn Vampire with Phyrexian Altar or Warren Soultrader under eminence: every recast makes a token, two sacrifices pay the next recast, and Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Impact Tremors each turn the unbounded deaths and casts into a kill. Commander Spellbook confirms 14 loops in the list. Nine tutors find any half; a hand-only simulation (ignoring mana, Necropotence and draw) puts a complete pair in hand 47% of the time by turn 4 and 58% by turn 6, against 8% and 10% with no tutors.

Skeleton: 31 lands, 13 fast mana and ramp, 9 tutors, 9 card advantage, 13 loop halves and drain, 4 outlets, 10 combat, 7 interaction and protection, 3 recursion and doubling. Measured after the build: avg MV 2.57, 35 nonland cards at MV 2 or less and 50 at MV 3 or less, 14 Game Changers (no cap at Bracket 4), 61 of 83 pips black. Mana Crypt, Jeweled Lotus and Dockside Extortionist are banned, verified.

Self-hits named (deck-brain 1.3): Olivia's Wrath kills Esper Sentinel and Warren Soultrader (Enduring Tenacity dies and returns as an enchantment, which is fine). Deflecting Swat, Deadly Rollick, Flawless Maneuver, Akroma's Will and Jeska's Will all read 'if you control a commander': Edgar in the command zone is not controlled, so none of them is free or double-moded while he sits there; they are in the pool, not the 100. The lifegain loops are mandatory triggers with no 'may', which is exactly the automatic class the pilot's older loop rule excluded and this brief allows.

Lines worth knowing: turn-1 Dark Ritual into Sorin, turn-2 Sorin -3 puts Bloodthirsty Conqueror onto the battlefield, turn-3 Vito or Blight-Priest and the table is dead. Vampiric Tutor or Imperial Seal with Necropotence out is a one-mana tutor to hand at end step; with Bolas's Citadel it is cast from the top; with Twilight Prophet it is drawn on upkeep and drains its mana value. Diabolic Intent and Culling the Weak are paid with an eminence token. Citadel's sacrifice-ten with Exquisite Blood and any gain-to-loss half out starts the loop by itself.

waves.label: Wave 1 — Ashnod's Altar for Talisman of Hierarchy (pilot's call, applied 2026-11-03)
waves.note: The pilot asked why Ashnod's Altar was out. Re-derived against the list: it closes no loop on its own (colourless can't pay Oathsworn's {B}; Spellbook 14 loops before and after) and the combo theme runs it in 15% of lists, but it is a fifth free outlet that pays {C}{C} per eminence token. The pilot took it over the second coloured rock.

swaps.axis: free outlet that pays, over a rock that fixes
swaps.grounds: Every eminence token is {C}{C} from turn 2: with Skullclamp each token is two cards and a net mana after the re-equip; with Phyrexian Altar or Warren Soultrader out, one body to the coloured outlet and the other to Ashnod's makes the Oathsworn loop mana-positive, which pays Grim Monolith untaps, Wishclaw and The One Ring mid-loop; with Captivating Vampire it is free instant-speed steal-then-sacrifice removal. Talisman of Hierarchy was the second two-mana coloured rock; Arcane Signet stays as the first.
swaps.cost: Colourless only in a list with 61 of 83 pips black (Necropotence, Bolas's Citadel and Beseech the Mirror all want {B}{B}{B}), three mana up front, and dead until a body is on the table. W sources 24 to 23, B sources 32 to 31, avg MV 2.57 to 2.58.
swaps.verdictWhy: Judge after play whether the colourless burst gets used or the slot wanted a coloured rock.
